bases.label: 造物世界 · 3D
bases.description: 空白创造场地、物体布置、交互与连续创作

starters.label: 空白造物世界
starters.description: 有边界的 3D 空白地面，可行走、瞄准并持续创造物件与玩法。

bases.label: 3D 第一人称
bases.description: 摄像机、碰撞、装备与指向交互

starters.label: Blank start
starters.description: One room with floor, walls, player, HUD and the base runtime only. No targets, no pickups, no quest and no reward ledger.

starters.label: Training range
starters.description: Short playable sample: three targets, cover crates, one ammo crate, one one-time pickup and the range_basic quest.

bases.label: 2D 挖掘沙盒
bases.description: 可挖掘地形、材料合成、建造与分块存档

starters.label: Blank start
starters.description: Finite 48x24 generated map with dig, place, inventory and saving only. No recipes, no rewards, no tools and an empty inventory.

starters.label: Mining camp
starters.description: Finite 96x48 mining camp: dig soil and stone by hand, craft a stone pickaxe, mine coal and iron, smelt an iron ingot at the camp forge, craft an iron pickaxe, then build with stone bricks.

bases.label: 2D 横版
bases.description: 重力、跳跃、平台碰撞与检查点

starters.label: Blank start
starters.description: One flat room with the base runtime only: run, jump, platform collision, camera, basic attack and one save file. No checkpoint, target, reward or ability.

starters.label: Small ruins
starters.description: Three connected rooms with return paths, a one-time cache, a training dummy, a breakable crate, a double-jump pickup and a 190 px high ledge that only a double jump can clear.

bases.label: 2D 俯视
bases.description: 瓦片地图、人物碰撞、区域交互与背包

starters.label: Blank start
starters.description: Empty walkable room with the base runtime only: movement, collision, camera and save.

starters.label: Town
starters.description: One road, one shop, one NPC and one collect-and-deliver quest.

starters.label: 空白造物世界
starters.description: 有边界的 3D 空白地面，可行走、瞄准并持续创造物件与玩法。

bases.label: 造物世界 · 3D
bases.description: 空白创造场地、物体布置、交互与连续创作

starters.label: 空白造物世界
starters.description: 有边界的 3D 空白地面，可行走、瞄准并持续创造物件与玩法。

bases.label: 3D 第一人称
bases.description: 摄像机、碰撞、装备与指向交互

starters.label: Blank start
starters.description: One room with floor, walls, player, HUD and the base runtime only. No targets, no pickups, no quest and no reward ledger.

starters.label: Training range
starters.description: Short playable sample: three targets, cover crates, one ammo crate, one one-time pickup and the range_basic quest.

bases.label: 2D 挖掘沙盒
bases.description: 可挖掘地形、材料合成、建造与分块存档

starters.label: Blank start
starters.description: Finite 48x24 generated map with dig, place, inventory and saving only. No recipes, no rewards, no tools and an empty inventory.

starters.label: Mining camp
starters.description: Finite 96x48 mining camp: dig soil and stone by hand, craft a stone pickaxe, mine coal and iron, smelt an iron ingot at the camp forge, craft an iron pickaxe, then build with stone bricks.

bases.label: 2D 横版
bases.description: 重力、跳跃、平台碰撞与检查点

starters.label: Blank start
starters.description: One flat room with the base runtime only: run, jump, platform collision, camera, basic attack and one save file. No checkpoint, target, reward or ability.

starters.label: Small ruins
starters.description: Three connected rooms with return paths, a one-time cache, a training dummy, a breakable crate, a double-jump pickup and a 190 px high ledge that only a double jump can clear.

bases.label: 2D 俯视
bases.description: 瓦片地图、人物碰撞、区域交互与背包

starters.label: Blank start
starters.description: Empty walkable room with the base runtime only: movement, collision, camera and save.

starters.label: Town
starters.description: One road, one shop, one NPC and one collect-and-deliver quest.

starters.label: 空白造物世界
starters.description: 有边界的 3D 空白地面，可行走、瞄准并持续创造物件与玩法。
